mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sign_in_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sign_date = #{signDate}
SELECT * FROM sign_in_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sign_date DESC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(streak), 0) FROM sign_in_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(points), 0) FROM sign_in_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT user_id AS userId, COUNT(*) AS signInDays, SUM(points) AS totalPoints FROM sign_in_record GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY totalPoints DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
